about.en: PumpBTC is a Bitcoin liquid-staking protocol built on Babylon that issues pumpBTC for staked BTC. PUMP is its governance token, the ERC-20/BEP-20 token at 0xB7C0007ab75350c582d5eAb1862b872B5cF53F0C on Ethereum and BNB Chain, which venues list under the PUMPBTC ticker. It is not pumpBTC, the BTC-backed staking receipt, and is unrelated to Pump.fun's PUMP.
